name: samirandaly.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: samirandaly.com scores 61 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 114 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /ar/, /ar/customer/account/login/referer/aHR0cHM6Ly9zYW1pcmFuZGFseS5jb20vYXIvY3VzdG9tZXIvYWNjb3VudC9pbmRleC8~/, /ar/customer/account/login/referer/aHR0cHM6Ly9zYW1pcmFuZGFseS5jb20vYXIvd2lzaGxpc3Qv/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed…
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 71 elements on /, /ar/, /ar/customer/account/login/referer/aHR0cHM6Ly9zYW1pcmFuZGFseS5jb20vYXIvY3VzdG9tZXIvYWNjb3VudC9pbmRleC8~/, for example .logo and a[data-bind="scope: 'wishlist'"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (6 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), Microsoft Clarity (3 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au, _ga_ST2PRWX8QP, _ga_K9SNGNP3BK, _fbp,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 8 elements on /, /ar/, for example .price-box.price-final_price[data-product-id="27546"] > .special-price > .price and .price-box.price-final_price[data-product-id="27545"] > .special-price > .price. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.
